decisions.reason: Operator training builds directly on the firm's application know-how and training capabilities, so management can interpret customer feedback, improve the programme, and use it to support machine sales.
The fourth rotary axis is a modular accessory that extends the firm's core milling systems, which in-house R&D and testing can refine at low cost.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the firm's established knowledge base, only mentioned on the website, and the firm lacks the related knowledge to absorb early results, so its resources are better redirected to core development.
The high-speed CNC milling line is the firm's core competence, given a page of its own and launched with several models, so the firm can assimilate market feedback and keep improving it.
The automatic tool change system builds on existing machine and tool expertise and strengthens the configurable system offer, so it fits the firm's absorptive capacity.
